It's always been this way. Before me, before you, before the ones who came be- fore you. Back and back and back." His v oice trailed the familiar phrase. "Jonas," The Giver said, after a moment, "it's true that it has been this way for what seems forever. But the memories tell us that it has not always been. People felt things once. You and I have been part of that, so we know. We know that they once felt things like pride, and sorrow, and -- " "And love," Jonas added, remembering the family scene that had so affe cted him. "And pain." He thought again of the soldier. "The worst part of holding the memories is not the pain. It's the loneli ness of it. Memories need to be shared."
